texts: good. the spring storm with its storm genus, the day-605/Year-2 date and the struck harbor are all carried; the only thing to know is that "in the early evening" becomes one fused "early evening" time constant, so a later question asked about plain "evening" will not match it.
good. the three boats become a counted group, and "were at sea" distributes to each boat through a fireable rule, so any boat later identified as one of them inherits the position.

good. "the three boats" is recognized as the same group as the previous sentence, the Harbor Row lanterns are typed and tied to the row, and the following is recorded both as a group event and per boat.

bad: the adverb "early" has no slot in the translator's vocabulary, so it is dropped silently — the parse says only that the keepers refilled the mire-essence at some past time, and the point of the sentence, that they did it ahead of time, is lost. Rewrite the timing as a clause of its own: "The keepers of the Harbor Row refilled the mire-essence before the storm struck." — that parses as an explicit ordering against the storm already introduced in sentence 1, and everything else in the sentence is unchanged. If "early" instead means earlier than their usual hour, name the hour or the day-part ("The keepers of the Harbor Row refilled the mire-essence in the afternoon."), since "earlier than usual" has no carrier at all.
good. the keepers and the lanterns are both linked back to their earlier mentions, "against the wind" is kept on the shielding, and the action also distributes to each keeper.
good. the lanterns are the ones introduced in sentence 3, the burning is recorded for the group and per lantern, and "through the storm" is kept as the stated relation to the same storm.

good. "all three boats" becomes a per-boat rule over the group of three, carrying the harbor and "safely"; being a rule rather than a single fact, it answers about a particular boat only once that boat is identified as one of the three.

good. "one of the three boats" is encoded as a one-boat subset of the three, and "was on" keeps the stated position under past tense. Worth knowing: a subset is not a named member, so nothing about Joren Salt's own boat reaching the harbor derives from sentence 7.
good. the station is attached to Meren Tallowhand, and "before dawn" is carried as an upper bound on the time of the reaching.
